content: ¿Doa bur dule-dummadi?
A-ibagangi, deun Jesús-e-sapingan Jesúsʼse nonimalad, ega sognonimalad: —Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaidgi, ¿doa bur-dule-dummadi?
Jesús machi-bipigwad-wargwense gochad. Emar-abargi ogwisgunonikid.
Geb e-sapinganga sogded: —Napira an bemarga soged, ar bemar machi-bipigwa-daedyob gusulile, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaidse geg be dogmalad.
Ar degisoggu, dule we-mimmiyob na san-bipii imakele, a-dule, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaidgi dule-dummaddo.
Ar dule an-nuggine we-mimmiyobid-wargwen ber nue-weligwar abingaele, ar an-abinganaiyob gunaido.
Isguedgi-aimar-oichoged igar-buledid

Jesús sogdebalid: “Ar dule we-mimmi-burwigana-angi-bensurmalad-isguega-imakele, nue-dummad wilegoed. We-dule-deyob-emar-oichosad e-dukargi akwamuu-dummad-edilleged, degi, deyob, dii-wilagi-egwaleged bur-nabirid.
We-napneggi ibmar-galagwensuli Bab-Dummadgi-isguega-emar-imaked, doggus wilub-obichagusad, gwen bargalegosulid. Ar dule emar-gwage-ichodiiddina, duledar-wilesdo.

”Degisoggu, ar be-argan isguega be-imakdibe, be-nag isguega be-imakdibe, bur be sike, begi-dikasur be mete. Ar argan-wargwen-nika degisadegudigued, bur nabirid. Ar nag-wargwen-nika degisadegudigued bur nabirid. Ar bur undarad, be argan-warbo-nika, degi, mali-warbo-nika, be soo-saila-geg-berguedse bur melleder.
Ar be-ibya isguega be-imakdibe, bur ibya be onoge, begi-dikasur-meted be imake. Ar bur-nabirsursi, ibya-gwagwen-nika dulagudigued. Ar bur undarad, ibya-gwabo-nika soo-saila-geg-berguedse melleder.”
Sibad-wawaad-yoggusadgi burbar sunmaklenaid
Jesús sogdebalid: “Nue be salakarmar, mer ibgwensur we-burwigana be dakmalo. Ar napira an bemarga soged, ar nibneggi e-baliwiturmar an-Bab-nibneggi-maid-walik gudigumalad.
[Ar ani, Dule-Machi, an nonigu, dulemar-yoggus-gudimalad-abonogega an nonikid.]

”Igi be binsamala. Dule-wargwen dulatar-na-sibad-wawaad-nikad (100) ei wargwen yoggusale, ¿ar dulabake-gakambe-gakabakebakad (99) sapurba-obes nadsulir be insae, ei-wargwen-yoggusad aminaega? Obesale, ei-wargwen-yoggusad aminaegar.
”Napira an bemarga soged. Ar we-sibad-wawaad-wargwenad-aminonikile, sibad-wawaad-dulabake-gakambe-gakabakebak-yoggussulidba (99) bur weligwar itosaled.
Degisoggu, be-Bab-nibneggi-maid, sibad-wawaadyob we-bipigana-wargwensaar ei yoggubisur abemaid.”
Gwenadbo igar-naboged
Jesús sogdebalid: “Degisoggu, be-gwenad begi nosale, ese be nao. Unnila bebo-apinni-siidgi nue ega be sogo, nue be angi nosye. Ar be-gwenad nabir be-itosale, be-gwenad be-aiga gannar gunonikoed.
”Ar be-gwenad be-itosulile, dule-wargwendibe, dule-warbodibe, beba be nidoed, adi, bela be-ibmar-sogoed, wemar bela be-itomarmogoed.

”Ar be-gwenad wemar-wagab be-itosulile, geb bela Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-abargi ega be ibmar sogoed. Ar be-gwenad amba amar-abargi be-itosulile, dule-Bab-Dummad-wissurmaladyob be we-gwenad-daksunnoed, degine, Roma-dummadga-mani-gaedgi-arbamaladyob be we-dule dakbaloed.

”Napira an bega soged, ar bela be we-napneggi be-ibmar-sogsadba galenonikile, nibneggi bela galenonimogoed. Ar bela be we-napneggi be-ibmar-sogsadba igar-egasale, nibneggi bela deyob igar-egalemogoed.
”Inniki an bemarga soged. Ar bemar-warbo we-napneggi Bab-Dummadse-ibmar-egisega, be emarbi-binsamalale, ar ibu be egisbimala, an-Bab-nibneggi-maid a-ibmar bemarga imakoed.
Ar bia bemar-warbo, warbaadibe, an-nuggi ambikunonimalale, an bato bemar-abargi gudiid.”
Geb degi, Pedro Jesúsʼse walikgunonikid, ega sogded: —Dummad, An-gwenad-angi-nosadga, ¿ilabigwa angi nossulidyob an dakoe? ¿Ilagugledsega (7)?
Jesús abin-sogded: —Unnila ilagugleye (7) an bega sogsulid. An bega soged, dulapaagwad-gakambe-ilaguglese (77) be-gwenad begi nossulidyob be dakoed.
Mai-gwensak, dule-egi-nosad-abingabi gussulid
Jesús sogdebalid: “A-ulale, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaiddi, ar rey-wargwen e-maimar-egi-mani-ganikid-ebo igar-nabirogega ese gocha-gusadyobdo.
Wargwen-egi-mani-ganikid ese nonigu, dakleardo, mani-sibu-mili-miliba (10,000) egi ganiki.
Ar we-dule mani-satesoggu, geg e-dummad-bennuked. A-ular, e-dummad ega sogdesunnad, ‘Be-ome, be-mimmimar, degi, bela be-ibmar-nikad be manigi ukna, adi, agi be an-bennukoed.’
”Geb a-maide, yokorgi e-dummad-asabin sindigar sigis imaksad, egi wilenaigusad, ega sognaigualid: ‘Dummad, mer be doga-doga an-imakgwele. Bela an be-bennukoed.’
Ar rey, wile na e-mai-dakdegu, ega sogdesunnad: ‘Be angi bar mani ganisurdo.’ Degisoggu, e-mai-ollor-imaksad.
”Geb rey-e-mai, e-dummad-walik-sii nodgu, dule-ebo-arbaed egi mani-sibu-dulatar-ganikid (100) abingualid. Geb rey-e-mai a-dule-gammuyaa ganonikid, ega sogded: ‘Angi be-mani-ganikid, be an-bennuk.’
”Geb agi ebo-arbaed egi wilenaigusanad, ega sognaigusanad: ‘Mer doga-doga be an-imake. Bela an be-bennukoed.’
”Ar rey-e-mai, we-dule-ebo-arbaed-gwen-itobi gussulid. Aka esgaryase dule-egi-mani-ganikid-metedapid, adi, bela-egi-mani-ganikid e-bennukegar.
Rey-e-maibo-arbamalad deyob daksamargu, bukib binsadmalad. Geb e-dummad-reyga emar-na-ibmar-daksamalad bela sogdapmalad.
”Geb degi, e-dummad-rey, e-mai-egi-mani-gani-gusadse gochad, ega sogded: ‘¡Mai, be dule-isgana! Be angi wilenaigusgu, bela-be-angi-mani-ganikid an bela bega osulosad.
Ar igi an wile be-daksamoga, ¿ar be deyob bebo-arbaed geg be wile-dakmosi?’
Geb degi, e-dummad uludgu, we-mai-isgana dulemar-sabsur-odurdakmaloedga urmaksasunnad, adi, bela-egi-mani-ganikid e-bennukegar.”
Geb degi, Jesús sogded: “Ar bemar bela gwagegi na be-gwenad-begi-nosad be ega sogsurmalar, igi-barsaye, deyobi an-Bab-nibneggi-maid bemar-sabsur-imakmarmogoed.”
